# Isaiah Chapter 61 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 11 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*Anointed to proclaim; liberty to captives; year of favor; oaks of righteousness; garment of praise*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**The Year of the LORD's Favor:** Anointed to proclaim; liberty to captives; year of favor; oaks of righteousness; garment of praise. The key message for modern readers: "The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me, because the LORD has anointed me to bring good news to the poor"

*-- PNEUMA*
